description: This Java class 'ExpectationDTO' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for serializing and deserializing 'Expectation' objects within the MockServer framework. It includes fields for request matching, responses, callbacks, forwarding, errors, and timing configurations, along with methods to build 'Expectation' objects from DTOs and vice versa.
